<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var panel  = document.querySelector('.grid7-left');
    var burger = document.querySelector('.mobilemenu');
    if (!panel || !burger) return;

    // το πάνελ πρέπει να είναι πλαίσιο αναφοράς για το absolute
    if (getComputedStyle(panel).position === 'static') {
        panel.style.position = 'relative';
    }

    var x = document.createElement('span');
    x.className = 'menu-close';
    x.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    x.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close menu');
    x.innerHTML = '×';

    var s = x.style;
    s.setProperty('position', 'absolute', 'important');
    s.setProperty('top', '0px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('right', '10px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('left', 'auto', 'important');
    s.setProperty('width', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('height', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('line-height', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('text-align', 'center', 'important');
    s.setProperty('font-size', '32px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('font-family', 'Arial, sans-serif', 'important');
    s.setProperty('color', '#666', 'important');
    s.setProperty('cursor', 'pointer', 'important');
    s.setProperty('z-index', '5', 'important');

    x.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        burger.click();
    });

    panel.insertBefore(x, panel.firstChild);

    // κρύψιμο στο desktop (το μενού εκεί είναι πάντα ανοιχτό)
    var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 992px)');
    function toggleX() {

                && container.has(e.target).length === 0
                && !$('a.search').is(e.target)

            // same for search button...

                && container.has(e.target).length === 0
                && !$('a.search').is(e.target)
                && $('a.search').has(e.target).length === 0){

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

    var burger = document.querySelector('.mobilemenu');

    // το πάνελ πρέπει να είναι πλαίσιο αναφοράς για το absolute
    if (getComputedStyle(panel).position === 'static') {
        panel.style.position = 'relative';
    }

    var x = document.createElement('span');
    x.className = 'menu-close';
    x.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    x.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close menu');
    x.innerHTML = '×';

    var s = x.style;
    s.setProperty('position', 'absolute', 'important');
    s.setProperty('top', '0px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('right', '10px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('left', 'auto', 'important');
    s.setProperty('width', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('height', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('line-height', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('text-align', 'center', 'important');

    s.setProperty('font-family', 'Arial, sans-serif', 'important');
    s.setProperty('color', '#666', 'important');
    s.setProperty('cursor', 'pointer', 'important');
    s.setProperty('z-index', '5', 'important');

    x.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        burger.click();
    });

    panel.insertBefore(x, panel.firstChild);

        x.style.setProperty('display', mq.matches ? 'block' : 'none', 'important');
    }
    toggleX();

});

var delayTimer;
        var delay = 500;
        
        // 1. on text input change...
        $(".searchModal input").on('change keyup paste', function() {
            clearTimeout(delayTimer);
            
            $("#searchResults").show();
            
            delayTimer = setTimeout(function(){
                var txt = $(".searchModal input").val();
                var url = "/el/ajax_search/&modonly=1";
                
                if( txt == "" ) {
                    $(".searchModal #searchResults ul").html("");
                }
                else {
                    txt = txt.replace(" ", "_");
                    
                    $.post(
                        url,
                        { keywords: txt },
                        function(data) {
                            $(".searchModal #searchResults ul").html(data);
                        }
                    );
                }
            }, delay);                        
        });
        
        // 2. hide the modal if user clicks outside
        $(document).mouseup(function (e){
            var container = $(".searchModal #searchResults");
            
            // if the target of the click isn't the container...
            // ... nor a descendant of the container
            // same for search button...
            if (!container.is(e.target)
                && container.has(e.target).length === 0
                && !$('a.search').is(e.target)
                && $('a.search').has(e.target).length === 0){
                    container.hide();
                }
        });

            var container = $(".searchModal #searchResults");
            
            // if the target of the click isn't the container...
            // ... nor a descendant of the container
            // same for search button...
            if (!container.is(e.target)
                && container.has(e.target).length === 0
                && !$('a.search').is(e.target)
                && $('a.search').has(e.target).length === 0){

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var panel  = document.querySelector('.grid7-left');
    var burger = document.querySelector('.mobilemenu');
    if (!panel || !burger) return;

    // το πάνελ πρέπει να είναι πλαίσιο αναφοράς για το absolute
    if (getComputedStyle(panel).position === 'static') {
        panel.style.position = 'relative';
    }

    var x = document.createElement('span');
    x.className = 'menu-close';
    x.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    x.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close menu');
    x.innerHTML = '×';

    var s = x.style;
    s.setProperty('position', 'absolute', 'important');
    s.setProperty('top', '0px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('right', '10px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('left', 'auto', 'important');
    s.setProperty('width', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('height', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('line-height', '36px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('text-align', 'center', 'important');
    s.setProperty('font-size', '32px', 'important');
    s.setProperty('font-family', 'Arial, sans-serif', 'important');
    s.setProperty('color', '#666', 'important');
    s.setProperty('cursor', 'pointer', 'important');
    s.setProperty('z-index', '5', 'important');

    x.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        burger.click();
    });

    panel.insertBefore(x, panel.firstChild);

    // κρύψιμο στο desktop (το μενού εκεί είναι πάντα ανοιχτό)
    var mq = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 992px)');
    function toggleX() {
        x.style.setProperty('display', mq.matches ? 'block' : 'none', 'important');
    }
    toggleX();
    mq.addListener ? mq.addListener(toggleX) : mq.addEventListener('change', toggleX);
});

        // 1. on text input change...
        $(".searchModal input").on('change keyup paste', function() {
            clearTimeout(delayTimer);
            
            $("#searchResults").show();
            
            delayTimer = setTimeout(function(){
                var txt = $(".searchModal input").val();
                var url = "/el/ajax_search/&modonly=1";
                
                if( txt == "" ) {
                    $(".searchModal #searchResults ul").html("");
                }
                else {
                    txt = txt.replace(" ", "_");
                    
                    $.post(
                        url,
                        { keywords: txt },
                        function(data) {
                            $(".searchModal #searchResults ul").html(data);
                        }
                    );
                }
            }, delay);                        
        });
        
        // 2. hide the modal if user clicks outside
        $(document).mouseup(function (e){
            var container = $(".searchModal #searchResults");
            
            // if the target of the click isn't the container...
            // ... nor a descendant of the container
            // same for search button...
            if (!container.is(e.target)
                && container.has(e.target).length === 0
                && !$('a.search').is(e.target)
                && $('a.search').has(e.target).length === 0){
                    container.hide();
                }
        });
